description: Friday 07:25: Lena Whitaker emails Ryan, in a new thread, her make-up log as she scanned it on the training room copier on Thursday, after Wednesday's make-up night: Elena Petrova (S6) and Louis Brennan (S7) done 12/9, Monique Daley (S8) no show, and a new line, Brandon Hughes (S9, left 7:55) done. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it.
